title: Rosymorn Firewine
summary: Provides 1 Camp Supply or can be drunk or thrown.

fields.Drink: Bonus Action. Alcohol imposes disadvantage on Dexterity and Charisma checks for 2 turns.
fields.Throw: Action. Creates a permanent Alcohol surface in a 13 ft radius. Fire turns it to Fire then Ash after 2 turns. Cold turns it to Ice then Water after 2 turns.

changes: Added native BG3 rules using pinned item and linked gameplay sources.
